name: Gluetun Rotate
description: Moves Gluetun to another VPN server when the IPTV provider refuses the current exit address.
author: PilaScat

fields.label: API key *
fields.help_text: A Dispatcharr API key. Settings → Users → the account whose key you want to use. The watcher needs it to read the provider accounts it asks.

fields.label: Gluetun key *
fields.help_text: An API key from Gluetun's control server auth file, for a role allowed GET /v1/publicip/ip, GET /v1/vpn/status and PUT /v1/vpn/status.

fields.label: Gluetun URL
fields.help_text: Gluetun's control server as seen from Dispatcharr. Change it only if HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_ADDRESS was moved.

actions.label: Apply settings
actions.description: Applies the settings above and starts the watcher.

actions.label: Check status
actions.description: Reports the exit address and what the watcher did recently.

actions.label: Ask the provider
actions.description: Asks every account now, without moving the tunnel.

actions.label: Restart watcher
actions.description: Starts the watcher again if it is down.

actions.label: Stop watcher
actions.description: Stops the watcher and leaves the tunnel where it is.

confirm.title: Stop the watcher?
confirm.message: A refused exit address will no longer move Gluetun to another server.
